questions.stem: Once water reaches the xylem in the root, what mainly drives it upwards through the plant?

options.text: Active transport by xylem cells pushes water upwards
Gravity pulls water up through the narrow xylem vessels
The transpiration pull created by water evaporating from the leaves
Osmosis between xylem vessels pushes water from cell to cell

questions.explanation: The main force driving water up through the xylem is the transpiration pull. As water evaporates from the leaves during transpiration, it creates a tension that pulls water upwards through the continuous column of water in the xylem vessels.
